summary: A native Claude read of a stream item now gives its conversation entry a delivery link, as a graph message's read always has. Conversation cursors gain a sixth number, the stream lifecycle position, so a later stream receipt is reported as a changed delivery.

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change. The proof was already recorded in the messages shard's read record; now it is read too.

schema.detail: One partial expression index on the messages shard's member-local stream_lifecycle (reader, native session, native message, for reads), built at open with CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS: 0.2 s for a million lifecycle rows. Nothing replicated changes.

rules.detail: The same qualification as graph receipts: the reader's own record in that session, at most three physical receipts per native message, and no link when two qualify.

compatibility.detail: Conversation cursors are opaque and only the issuing member parses them. A five-field cursor from before this build still parses, as having seen no stream receipts: its first replay reports delivery-link-changed once if the owner has a stream receipt, and the client refreshes that page. A six-field cursor given to a member that rolled back is a cursor-gap, which resyncs once.

downtime.detail: The index builds at the shard's open: 0.2 s per million lifecycle rows.

recovery.detail: Rolling back drops nothing; the previous release ignores the index and shows no delivery links for stream items, as before.
